title: Every PHP site image ships session.upload_progress off and refuses a base below the 19 Nov 2026 PHP releases
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/web-php-security.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.
expect: The ini sets session.upload_progress.enabled = 0; joomla, wordpress and demos Dockerfiles copy it into conf.d and check it at build time; all three carry the same PHP floor; build.sh hashes it for PHP images only; every IMAGE_TAGS line and DEMOS_IMAGE are on 20261120-r1.
evidence: 20/11/2026: 111/114 production and 60/60 dev site containers on PHP 8.3.36/8.4.27 with session.upload_progress.enabled=1 (CVE-2026-126714, CVE-2026-115560, fixed in 8.3.37/8.4.28 on 19/11/2026). Dev-host build from this branch: wordpress php8.3 -> 8.3.37 up=0, demos -> 8.4.28 up=0, old 8.3.36 base refused by the floor.
fence: A PHP site image never builds on a base below the patched floor, and never ships with session upload progress on.

tests: the PHP security ini turns session.upload_progress off (CVE-2026-126714, CVE-2026-115560)
every PHP image carries the same patched-PHP floor
every IMAGE_TAGS line and the demo farm image moved to the patched 20261120-r1 tag
